note: H7's forward dividend table (FORWARD_RULE_H7.md, fcc1f4d, section 2: the cash dividend per share whose ex-date is the statement date A, from a committed table of announced ex-dates, each row with its source, with a complete_through date per name; a trade whose A is past that date fails loudly and waits — a dividend is never assumed to be 0 because a row is missing), read by forward_h7_h9.py. It replaces data/dividends_forward.json (committed 712b0ad), which also served H9's every-night series; H9 was withdrawn from the forward job by the owner on 2026-10-23 and that table went with it. H7's rule pays only a dividend whose ex-date is a statement date A, so this table holds only those: per name, 'ex' lists every cash distribution whose ex-date falls on a scheduled FOMC statement date (the FOMC_DECISION dates of data/macro_events_2022_2027.json from 2026-10-28), keyed by ex-date, each with its amount per share (null until the fund declares it: a statement row on such a date fails loudly until the amount is added) and its source; 'complete_through' is the last date through which that list is CLAIMED complete — every ex-date on or before it that falls on a statement date is listed. Ex-dates on other days are not listed (no H7 trade can pay them).
